title: Glowing slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow aura around the pizza -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFB300' stop-opacity='0.08'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Pizza slice - crust at bottom, point at top -->
  <!-- Crust (bottom edge) -->
  <path d='M 18 80 Q 50 96 82 80 L 50 14 Z' fill='#C97B1E'/>
  <!-- Crust lighter top edge -->
  <path d='M 18 80 Q 50 92 82 80 Q 82 84 50 88 Q 18 84 18 80 Z' fill='#E8A33D'/>
  <!-- Cheese filling -->
  <path d='M 23 78 Q 50 90 77 78 L 50 20 Z' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- Cheese lighter center highlight -->
  <path d='M 32 74 Q 50 82 68 74 L 50 32 Z' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <!-- Sauce peeking through -->
  <path d='M 38 68 Q 50 76 62 68 L 54 45 Q 46 42 45 50 Z' fill='#E53935'/>

  <!-- Pepperoni 1 -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='58' r='6' fill='#D32F2F'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#F44336'/>
  <!-- Pepperoni 2 -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='5.5' fill='#D32F2F'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='60.5' r='2' fill='#F44336'/>
  <!-- Pepperoni 3 (small, near tip) -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='44' r='4' fill='#D32F2F'/>
  <circle cx='51.3' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#F44336'/>

  <!-- Cheese drips -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='76' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='75' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='80' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <!-- Crust texture spots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='82' r='2' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='85' r='2.2' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='82' r='2' fill='#B5651D'/>

  <!-- Basil leaves -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#4CAF50' transform='rotate(-30 40 50)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='54' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#4CAF50' transform='rotate(25 62 54)'/>

  <!-- Shine lines for glow effect -->
  <path d='M 38 30 L 42 26' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M 58 32 L 61 28' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M 48 22 L 50 18' stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
